channel.title: HGS Studio Journal
channel.description: Printmaking, works on paper and the art of Bisbee, Arizona.

item.title: How to Hang Art at the Right Height
item.description: Hang art like a gallery: the 57-inch center rule, how to measure for the nail, spacing for gallery walls and art above sofas, plus an interactive hanging-height calculator.

item.title: Life Is a Process, as Is Art
item.description: Simplify, purge, transition: a practical framework for artists juggling family, teaching and a studio, and for making room to build a real body of work.

item.title: Mail Art: How to Start a Mail Art Exchange
item.description: A practical guide to mail art: what it is, how to run an open call or swap, postal rules for decorated envelopes and postcards, and how to exhibit the work you receive.

item.title: Wall Musings: The Eight-Hour Wall Drawing
item.description: Why make a drawing directly on a gallery wall in a single day? Notes on wall drawing as performance, materials that work on drywall, and how to plan a durational drawing.

item.title: Stitches and Folds: Sewing on Paper
item.description: How to sew on paper by machine and by hand: choosing paper and thread, stitch length, folding paper garments and dress forms, and ideas for sketchbook projects.

item.title: Anniversary Art Gifts by Year
item.description: Traditional anniversary materials as art prompts: paper prints and books for the first year, cotton for the second, leather for the third, and handmade gift ideas for each.

item.title: How to Print a Linoleum Block
item.description: A step-by-step guide to printing a linocut: inking with a brayer, registering paper, burnishing by hand or pulling on a proof press, plus fixes for common problems.

item.title: Paper Quilts: Collagraph Texture
item.description: Collagraph printmaking explained: build a printing plate from cardboard, fabric and gel medium, ink it intaglio or relief, and piece prints together like a quilt.

item.title: Making Artists' Books
item.description: An introduction to artists' books: simple structures like the pamphlet stitch, accordion and Japanese stab binding, the tools you need, and how to think about a book as an artwork.

item.title: The Dos and Don'ts of Collecting Artists' Prints
item.description: How to buy original prints with confidence: what edition numbers mean, original prints vs. reproductions, how to check paper and signatures, and how to care for prints at home.

item.title: Date Night in Bisbee: The Art Walk
item.description: How to spend an evening on Bisbee's gallery walk: where to start in Old Bisbee, how to pace Main Street, Subway Street and Brewery Gulch, and tips for an art-filled date night.

item.title: Original Art for a Little Scratch
item.description: How to own original art on a modest budget: small works, open studios, print editions and when a giclée is the right choice, with an honest look at pigments and paper.
